build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build -p regards-cli && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build --release -p regards-cli && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src regards-mail: http://regards-mail.localhost
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://localhost:1420; frame-src regards-mail: http://regards-mail.localhost
